_comment: CHURN CARD — BASE RE-RUN on the LATER exe.  Byte-for-byte the same treatment as
_ft63_churn_base.json (zero functional keys over it; only the output paths differ), run
on the build that additionally carries the D5 v5 carried-only gate and the Card-3/4
slip-aware election.  Both of those are default-OFF, so this arm must reproduce
WHY IT EXISTS.  base / v3 / v4 were run on one exe; v5 needs a later one.  Standing
invariant #6 forbids reading a cross-build delta as a treatment effect — verification
integers are build-sensitive at the ppm level.  This arm makes the v5-vs-base comparison
a SAME-BUILD one, and simultaneously discharges the OFF-path byte-identity gate the two
new knobs owe: if churn_base2 differs from churn_base anywhere, the default-OFF claim is
false and every ON-arm number in this card is unattributable.
